description: arXiv search, find research papers and academic papers. Search arXiv for research papers by keywords, title, author or category (e.g. cs.AI): title, authors, abstract, categories, dates, and the abstract and PDF links, newest or most relevant first. Metadata from arXiv (CC0). Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
